gaps.explanation: Budgetary Comparison Schedule - General Fund (covers all governmental funds by department, pp9-12) prints 'Loan repayment' among its charges to appropriations: Fire 2,703 (p11) and Economic Development 16,654 (p11); total charges 956,941 (p12). The governmental funds statement (pp4-5) prints the same loan repayments under Other financing sources (uses) ('Loan repayments' Econ Dev (16,654), Other Governmental Funds (2,703), Total (19,357), p5), so its Total expenditures are 937,584 (p5). 956,941 - 2,703 - 16,654 = 937,584; gap 19,357 is entirely this classification difference. Detail lines are as printed; no fix.

The statement (pp4-5) prints transfers per fund column: Transfers from other funds Street 14,846 + Police 133,949 + Other Governmental Funds 48,873 = 197,668 (Total column 197,668, p5). The budget schedule treats all governmental funds as one budgetary 'General Fund' and prints Other financing sources 'Transfers from other funds' actual '-' (p10, budget 18,453), so interfund transfers net out on the schedule. Nothing to add: the schedule prints no transfer amount.

Statement Transfers to other funds: General (145,521) + Parks & Rec (644) (p4) + Housing (51,503) (p5) = (197,668), Total column (197,668) p5. The budget schedule (one budgetary fund covering all governmental funds) prints 'Transfers to other funds' actual '-' (p12, budget 11,200); interfund transfers net to zero on the schedule. No fix.
